assertions.assertion: the disabled run equals the deterministic baseline byte for byte
the enabled selection contains every disabled selection entry (monotonicity)
the disabled selection is exactly structural closure + representation coupling

ablation.statement: the model layer contributed 1 additional true positive(s) for 23 coins on this change

limits.no_completeness_guarantee: by Rice's theorem, deciding whether a change affects a test is undecidable
limits.oracle_definition: outcome_A(t) != outcome_B(t) over the full inventory at both revisions
limits.what_it_cannot_see: a test can be affected and still pass twice, so over-selection is invisible: a high recall does NOT mean the selection is tight, and an empty missed list means 'we missed nothing the instrument could see', not 'we missed nothing'
